# E-PHARMACY

E-PHARMACY helps visitors find public pharmacies and products in Ukraine.
Availability, pickup, delivery and final sale conditions are confirmed by the selected pharmacy.

## Public catalogs

- [Pharmacies](https://e-pharmacy-client-ten.vercel.app/pharmacies): Browse pharmacies, locations and public contact details.
- [Product catalog](https://e-pharmacy-client-ten.vercel.app/product-catalog): Browse products and compare pharmacy offers.

Private account pages and bank details are not part of the public catalog.
